title: Nonzero canonical codes of fixed size
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $i$, a full code of size $i$ is a switching block code on $w$ positions whose bits are zero outside its position set, whose position set has cardinality $i$, and whose bit value is $1$ at some position in that set.
